slice: Initial generated temporal schema kind and Instant precision gate
author: startup_owner_review
estimate_basis: Bounded compiler emitter plus both-adapter native schema controls; analogous to preceding Duration decoder and native temporal slice. Reassess if catalog validation cannot fit existing initialization ownership.

requirements.contract: TIME-D01/D24/D25: millisecond Instant, declared database kind/precision and typed decoding; incompatible legacy schema requires reviewed mapping.

requirements.observation: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS does not check existing native column kind; initializeSchema is already owned by initial startup/recovery transaction and budget.
Actual preexisting Duration TEXT accepts canonical numeric/wire values; TIMESTAMPTZ(6) loses submilliseconds through driver Date. Both gaps independently reproduced by root.

scope: Generate compiler-private expected catalog descriptors only for persisted fields whose representation root is Instant or Duration, including nominal refinements and nullable fields. Keep emitted storage representation and application/wire APIs unchanged.

After generated entity DDL/index initialization, before publish readiness, validate expected table/column physical type and Instant declared precision. Missing/wrong type, zoneless/unbounded/higher-precision Instant, or unexpected column nullability are contained schema failures.

PostgreSQL catalog lookup uses the transaction connection through initialization.execute and existing deadline. Resolve relation using the same quoted generated table name/search_path as CRUD; compare physical int8 and timestamptz identities, Instant typmod exactly3 and nullable flag. No separate pool, unbounded timer or new deadline.

SQLite reads PRAGMA table_info for the same generated relation and checks INTEGER-affinity physical declaration for Instant/Duration plus expected nullability. The fresh generated BIGINT declaration passes; preexisting TEXT/REAL/BLOB fails. Existing per-row decoders retain range/value checks. SQLite numeric coercion/storage drift after initialization stays residual.

Throw existing contained PersistenceFault rather than exposing catalog rows, SQL text, database identifiers or raw error data. Fatal initial schema contradiction prevents bind/ready; availability failure retains established live/notready/recovery classification.

No check emitted for projects without stored Instant/Duration fields; private delivery journal TEXT metadata is excluded. No new public syntax, legacy coercion, time algorithm, zone/default/provider/auth policy or runtime version claim.
native_checks: Keep existing actual generated bothDB temporal4/47 and host9/49 green; fresh compilation/schema/journals match canonical semantics.

Before generated import, create actual same named tables with Duration TEXT/REAL, Instant TEXT/zone-less or PostgreSQL timestamptz6/unbounded, and wrong temporal nullability; assert fatal initializer and safe route refusal without trusted typed output. Positive PostgreSQL BIGINT/TIMESTAMPTZ(3) and SQLite BIGINT/INTEGER-affinity/nullable declarations pass.

Use fresh owned processes per drift case, disposable explicit local PostgreSQL and SQLite stores, real catalog inspection only to establish fixtures and physical observations; actual generated initializer/handler owns admission. Preserve original diagnostic and initial failing controls.

At least one actual generated main per backend with incompatible existing schema proves process termination, no app/deployment listener or ready publication, safe bounded fault, and owning socket/backend cleanup. Preserve existing startup owner suites and original10s bound; an actual held catalog query must remain under the same owner budget.
Maintain both adapters in registered finite suite/runner, clear ambient selectors, and exercise refusal before allocation for nonlocal PG URLs. Existing runner modes remain unchanged.

Build fresh exact native CLI/core source pins in owned cache, compare intended emitted private gate delta vs approved baseline, record safe immutable source/receipt archives and submit for different-author review. Root integrates only leaf delta and runs fused supported gate.
residual_limits: This is an initial/recovery schema gate, not a per-query concurrent-DDL or after-ready physical drift guarantee. Full TIME-D25 remains open for those cases.

Stored out-of-range/corrupt values, higher-precision values introduced after readiness, all projections/joins/aggregates, CalendarDate/Time/Zone/Locale physical mappings, generated defaults/triggers and migration contracts are separate slices.
Accepted Time authority model versus current JSONB resolved-object representation requires its own scoped assessment; this gate does not silently revise that mapping.
Half-open local-day predicates remain blocked on separately reviewed parser/checker/public query prerequisite; no handwritten SQL/hostfilter substitutes.
Runtime Intl rule version remains genuinely unreported and bytes unattested; enum IANA2026c scope unchanged.

Imported initializer/handler cases do not qualify authentication. Only explicit native-main controls qualify their startup/listener boundaries. Whole RM-504 and broader RM402/RM403 limits remain open.
review_points: Check INTEGER-affinity acceptance is a physical SQLite kind check with explicit limited scope, not proof of every stored row or required CHECK ownership.
Check PostgreSQL relation resolution is identical to generated CRUD and typmod is enforced before driver Date truncation.
Check temporal nullable descriptor construction uses existing checked reference_is_nullable and representation_root_for.
Check added catalog phase retains original native startup and recovery transaction budget/cancellation/cleanup, fatal-versus-availability semantics and no readiness publication before validation.
stop_conditions: Need a new public language or migration mapping decision.
Catalog access escapes existing initialization owner or changes readiness/transaction semantics.
Plan expands into all temporal types, schema defaults/triggers, concurrent DDL or whole-TIME-D25 closure.

assessment.rationale: Accepted TIME-D01/D24/D25 specifies stored physical kind and millisecond precision. Native502 diagnostic proves current legacy-kind/precision gaps. Bounded initialization/recovery catalog gate can use existing owner transaction/execute/deadline without public language or mapping changes.
conditions: Same CRUD relation/search_path with pg_catalog built-in type identities; no cross-schema ambiguity.
SQLite INTEGER-affinity is declared physical type evidence only, not stored row/CHECK/corruption authority.
Same init transaction/budget and fatal-versus-availability classification; incompatible schema prevents actual main listeners/ready with cleanup.
After-ready concurrent DDL, wider types, Time representation mapping and complete TIME-D25 remain open.
Root integrates exact leaf only after different-author product review and full combined gate.
